description: This Java class defines an integration test for provisioning features of the Apache Fineract platform. It contains setup methods, and a comprehensive test method that creates clients, loan products, applies for loans, approves and disburses loans, and performs provisioning criteria creation, update, deletion, and provisioning entry creation. The class uses various helper classes for handling REST requests, loan operations, accounting, and provisioning.

classes.name: ProvisioningIntegrationTest
classes.description: A JUnit-powered integration test class that validates provisioning-related functionalities in the Fineract platform, including creation, update, deletion of provisioning criteria and entries, as well as the lifecycle of loans and clients involved in provisioning scenarios.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by initializing REST assured configurations, request and response specifications, helper instances, and assumptions to skip tests if existing provisioning entries are detected.

methods.name: testCreateProvisioningCriteria
methods.description: Performs an extensive test sequence: creates clients, loan products, applies, approves, and disburses loans, then creates, updates, deletes provisioning criteria, and finally tests provisioning entry creation and updates, validating each step's correctness.

methods.name: collaterals
methods.description: Constructs a HashMap representing collateral details for a given collateral ID and quantity.

methods.name: addCollaterals
methods.description: Adds collateral HashMaps to a list, used during loan application setup.

methods.name: validateProvisioningCriteria
methods.description: Validates that the retrieved provisioning criteria matches the request data, including categories and property values.

methods.name: checkProperty
methods.description: Checks equality of specific properties between the request and the retrieved provisioning criteria objects.

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Builds and creates a new loan product with specified configurations, returning its ID.

methods.name: applyForLoanApplication
methods.description: Creates a loan application JSON payload and submits it to create a loan, returning its ID.

methods.name: isAlreadyProvisioningEntriesCreated
methods.description: Checks whether provisioning entries for the current date already exist to prevent recreating entries.
